title: JSON Formatter
h1: JSON Formatter & Validator — Beautify and Check JSON
seoTitle: Free JSON Formatter — Format, Validate and Beautify JSON Online
description: Format, beautify and validate JSON instantly in your browser. Fix indentation, catch errors and copy clean output. Private and free.
intro: Paste raw JSON to format it with proper indentation, validate syntax and see clear error messages if something is wrong.
blurb: Format, beautify and validate JSON with clear error reporting.
howItWorks: Paste or type your JSON into the input box.
Choose indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces or tabs) and press Format.
Valid JSON is pretty-printed. Invalid JSON shows a clear error message.
examples: Turn minified JSON into readable multi-line output.
Quickly check if an API response is valid JSON.
Minify JSON to reduce size for storage or transmission.

faq.q: Does this send my JSON to a server?
faq.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.q: What kinds of errors does it catch?
faq.a: Syntax errors such as missing commas, trailing commas, unquoted keys and invalid numbers. The error message includes the approximate position.

faq.q: Can I minify JSON as well?
faq.a: Yes. Use the Minify button to remove all whitespace while keeping the data valid.
